title: Update Button Uses Current Filters
description: Editing the From date, the timezone, and the group-by all at once, then clicking Update, needs to send exactly what's currently in those fields — not whatever the page loaded with initially.
successCondition: After the initial page load's default report renders, changing all three of From, To, and Timezone to different values and clicking "Update" results in a data table and stat tiles that reflect the newly-selected range and timezone (different totals from the initial load, assuming the seeded data supports a visible difference) — not a report matching the original default query.
hints: The query object passed to loadSummary is recomputed from current from/to/groupBy/timeZone state on every render — a stale-closure bug would freeze it at initial values instead.
Choose a From/To range that's meaningfully different from the ~30-day default so any regression back to the initial query is obviously detectable.
